Shares computed from the counts the census published, which are the 2011 round -- the most recent Romanian census this project can open. The tables are read from the Internet Archive's copy of the office's own workbooks: every Romanian host is unreachable from this pipeline, insse.ro answering 'Network is unreachable' rather than refusing. Counts the census suppressed for disclosure control are left out of the composition rather than read as zero.
